# Alexander Maiso (Alex)

> Alexander Maiso, also known as Alex, is a Computer Engineer and Full-Stack Developer from the Philippines specializing in React, Next.js, Laravel, WordPress, Node.js, Python, IoT (ESP32, Arduino), and AI development. He builds production web applications, WordPress and WooCommerce sites, embedded IoT prototypes, and machine-learning experiments, and works remotely with international clients including companies in Canada.

## Projects

- ROADWATCH: IoT pothole geolocation system with ESP32-CAM, GPS, and 3D LiDAR
- Alexander Maiso E-commerce App: Headless platform with WordPress and WooCommerce backend, Next.js frontend
- Lex Karaoke: Karaoke web app with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase, and YouTube search
- WP Leads: Lead generation dashboard with Next.js, Google Sheets, and Google Apps Script (RSS polling, session auth)
- LearnEduColor LMS: E-learning platform with WordPress and Tutor LMS Pro
- Createlabz.io: IoT e-commerce store with WordPress and WooCommerce
- PawLitrax: Mobile app thesis with Flutter and PHP
- Lost and Found System: University system with C++ and MySQL
- Line Follower Robot: Arduino autonomous robot with IR sensors and L298N motor control
- WordPress Client Sites: Multiple small-business sites with Elementor Pro, WooCommerce, WooPayments, and Rank Math SEO

## Experience Highlights

- CMS Developer (Remote, Canada) for Educolor Press, Impossible Kids Foundation, and LearnEduColor — building and launching WordPress sites with Elementor Pro, WooCommerce, Tutor LMS Pro, and Stripe/WooPayments billing
- IoT / STEM Engineer Associate at Cloudline Technologies Inc (createlabz.io), Philippines — deploying IoT solutions connecting edge devices to cloud platforms for real-time data analytics
- WordPress Developer for C & L Physiotherapy Clinic (2021–2023) — plugin development, SSL certificate management, backups, and site security hardening
- Full-Stack Developer on personal projects — a Lost and Found desktop application in Java and MySQL, a C++ and MySQL replica for performance comparison, and a Laravel web application for learning MVC architecture
- Consistent on-page SEO delivery with Rank Math: meta titles and descriptions, Open Graph and Twitter Card tags, canonical URLs, robots directives, and structured data
